constraints.name: buckets_lifecycle_configuration_shape_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK (lifecycle_configuration IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(lifecycle_configuration) = 'object'::text AND lifecycle_configuration ? 'rules'::text AND
CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text) = 'array'::text THEN jsonb_array_length(lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text) >= 1 AND jsonb_array_length(lifecycle_configuration -> 'rules'::text) <= 1000
    ELSE false
END)

constraints.name: buckets_lifecycle_configuration_standard_only_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (type = 'STANDARD'::storage.buckettype OR lifecycle_configuration IS NULL AND lifecycle_configuration_generation IS NULL)

entries.semantic_assessment: Abandoned lifecycle artifacts and composite key
Applied database migration history, not app runtime table
Encrypted Vault source definition only; no secret values read
Full decryption view SQL read without running SELECT or reading secrets

catalog_projection.name: decrypted_secrets
catalog_projection.view_definition:
SELECT id,
    name,
    description,
    secret,
    convert_from(vault._crypto_aead_det_decrypt(message => decode(secret, 'base64'::text), additional => convert_to(id::text, 'utf8'::name), key_id => 0::bigint, context => '\x7067736f6469756d'::bytea, nonce => nonce), 'utf8'::name) AS decrypted_secret,
    key_id,
    nonce,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM vault.secrets s;
